children: Column CEO William Hockey announced four new products on September 16 covering stablecoin interoperability, full-stack card issuance, global banking, and multi-currency accounts with local payments. According to ChainCatcher, the products are designed to support USDC and USDT interoperability with U.S. dollars and U.S. and international payment rails on a 24/7 instant basis.

The launch also includes card issuance support for Mastercard and Visa, global banking services that can issue dollar or local-currency accounts and cards, and multi-currency accounts that allow foreign-currency payments and receipts with instant conversion to U.S. dollars. The products connect to systems including SEPA Instant.

Hockey said the offerings are built on the company’s own financial primitives and are fully composable. He said users can receive USDC, convert it to dollars, and distribute funds within seconds through FedNow, SWIFT, and card channels without stitching together multiple vendors, using Column alone to build financial products.

title: Column Launches Four New Products for Stablecoin Interoperability and Banking
